\section{Experimental Setup}
\paragraph{Task 1.} Qwen3-0.6B (non-thinking), first 40{,}000 eligible MetaMathQA examples (2 excluded for length, 0 GSM8K-test overlaps), 1{,}250 updates, effective batch 32, FP16 AMP. Full FT, Full FT + L2-SP ($\lambda=10^{-3}$), LoRA $r\in\{4,16\}$, OPLoRA ($r=16,k=128$). lm-eval 0.4.13, zero-shot. \todo{details to appendix}
\paragraph{Task 2.} Frozen SigLIP-B/16 features (196 tokens) $\to$ 2-layer MLP $\to$ Qwen3-0.6B; 3 stages (2{,}250/1{,}500/750 updates); LoRA $r=16$ on attention in stages 2--3. \todo{calibration scale, prompts}
\paragraph{Task 3.} Supplied 32-rollout pools (MATH / MathVista, 1{,}000 questions each; 200 dev / 800 held-out); 10 seeded orders; live FP16 run on 50 MATH questions. \todo{scorer versions}
